t: During the current fiscal year, none of the funds appropriated in this Act may be used to reduce the civilian medical and medical support personnel assigned to military treatment facilities below the September 30, 1995 level.

fable.w: This is an appropriations restriction that bars using funds to cut civilian medical staffing at military treatment facilities below a set level. The word "personnel" might tempt a reading that outside people are involved, but these are federal employees and the section sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: none of the funds appropriated in this Act may be used to reduce the civilian medical and medical support personnel assigned to military treatment facilities below the September 30, 1995 level

opus.w: This section only bars appropriated funds from being used to cut civilian medical staff at military treatment facilities below the September 30, 1995 level. It sets no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. The word "civilian" refers to federal employees, so no outside party takes part in any federal decision.
opus.b:
1. **Tempting reading:** There isn't really one. Someone might seize on the word "civilian," but these civilian medical staff work for the federal government. Nobody outside the government is consulted or involved in any decision.
2. **Why it fails:** The section only limits how appropriated money can be spent, so no participation crosses the federal boundary.
